coverage.reason: Defines the actors included in licensed firms.
Identifies STREAMS 2 and its replacement of STREAMS; analytical benefits are background.
Heading identifies the submission provisions.
Establishes the exclusive channel, effective date and required submission methods.
Permits XML submission and attaches footnote 3.
Permits completed prescribed PDF uploads and attaches footnote 3.
Permits completion of the web-based form without a footnote 3 marker.
Account registration heading.
Registration facilitation and instructions are outside the selected submission control; their email channel is not an STR filing alternative.
Transitional arrangements heading.
Introduces transitional arrangements using should; specific required provisions retain their express modality.
Defines the blackout boundaries and resumption time.
Preserves urgent direct contact during the blackout.
Fixes launch at 9:00am and distinguishes migration of earlier records from resubmission.
Adds XML schema and technical-test liaison requirements, dependent on missing material.
General query contact, not an additional submission channel.
Issuer division identification.
Issuer identification.
Document end marker.
Document reference identifier.
Historical introduction dates and reference to presentation material; not commencement dates.
First fragment of the presentation URL; target content is not supplied.
Continuation of the presentation URL; target content is not supplied.
Footnote marker links the exclusive-channel provision to resubmission.
Creates a separate obligation for post-implementation submissions through other channels.
Footnote marker connects XML and PDF methods to the certificate requirement.
Requires Hongkong Post e-Cert for the marked submission methods; implementation details are absent.

dimensions.explanation: The selected control concerns individual STR filings by the three specified classes of licensed firms. The general only-channel sentence does not justify extending this proposal to other actors.

Licensed firms is expressly defined. XML, prescribed PDF, web form and Hongkong Post e-Cert identify methods and credentials, but technical specifications and what constitutes satisfying the certificate requirement are incomplete.

Urgent direct contact belongs to the blackout arrangements. Footnote 3 attaches to XML and PDF; the supplied text does not attach it to the web form. Resubmission is a corrective obligation, not express permission to choose another channel.

Required and only establish the submission requirements. Should and please appear in registration and transition instructions; their presence does not erase the express XML and resubmission requirements. The urgent-contact wording does not establish that contact alone completes filing.

The general effective date is 2 February 2026, while launch and resumption are expressly at 9:00am that day. The selected post-launch control uses that launch boundary and preserves the blackout beginning at 12:00am on 28 January. The source does not specify a time zone or a resubmission deadline.

The XML schema, prescribed PDF specifications, registration form, presentation and future resubmission guidance are not supplied in full. Four missing dependency identifiers have no supplied mapping to particular references, so their contents cannot be inferred.

questions: What acts satisfy the e-Cert requirement for XML and PDF: possession, authentication, signing, or another specified use?
What time zone governs the blackout and launch times, and does following implementation in footnote 2 mean the stated 9:00am launch?
Does urgent blackout contact constitute submission, and what later filing procedure applies to reports handled through that contact?
What do the missing XML schema, prescribed PDF specifications and resubmission guidance require, including any resubmission deadline?
Which supplied references correspond to the four missing dependency identifiers?

assumptions: The assessed item is one STR filing or attempted filing.
Post-launch means at or after the stated 9:00am launch on 2 February 2026; it is supplied as a Boolean because the expression language has no timestamp type.
The certificate requirement attaches to the two methods carrying footnote 3. No competing web-form certificate requirement is supported by this packet.

citations.quote: licensed corporations, SFC-licensed virtual asset service providers and associated entities (collectively referred to as “licensed firms”)
Licensed firms are required to submit STRs to the JFIU via STREAMS 2 by one of the following means:
submission of an STR in an Extensible Markup Language (XML) format3;
uploading a completed STR form in the prescribed PDF format3; or
completing the web-based STR form in STREAMS 2.
upon the launch of STREAMS 2 at 9:00am on 2 February 2026
Hongkong Post e-Cert (electronic certificate) is required for this submission.

readings.distinction: This selected control tests channel, listed format and attached certificate requirement for one post-launch filing. It does not decide XML schema compliance, registration, STR substance, timeliness or remedial resubmission. The strongest unresolved issue is the operational meaning of requiring e-Cert.

facts.meaning: The submitting actor falls within the supplied definition of licensed firms.
facts.name: licensed_firm

facts.meaning: The assessed STR filing occurs at or after the stated 9:00am launch on 2 February 2026, using the applicable time zone once established.
facts.name: post_launch

facts.meaning: The assessed STR is submitted to the JFIU through STREAMS 2.
facts.name: via_streams_2

facts.meaning: The assessed submission is an STR in XML format; this fact alone does not establish compliance with the separately provided schema.
facts.name: xml_submission

facts.meaning: The assessed submission uploads a completed STR form in the prescribed PDF format.
facts.name: prescribed_pdf_upload

facts.meaning: The assessed submission completes the web-based STR form in STREAMS 2.
facts.name: completed_web_form

facts.meaning: The assessed submission satisfies the Hongkong Post e-Cert requirement in footnote 3; mere possession is not assumed sufficient.
facts.name: ecert_requirement_satisfied

formalization.result: (and via_streams_2 (or completed_web_form (and xml_submission ecert_requirement_satisfied) (and prescribed_pdf_upload ecert_requirement_satisfied)))

questions: What evidence establishes satisfaction of footnote 3?
readings.statement: [TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT] Within scope, true means the individual filing satisfies the selected post-launch channel, format and attached e-Cert control: it uses STREAMS 2 and either completes its web form, submits XML with the required e-Cert, or uploads a completed prescribed PDF with the required e-Cert. False means this selected control is not satisfied; an unknown input remains unknown.
readings.subject: Post-launch STR channel, format and e-Cert control

assumptions: The expressly timed transition provisions qualify application of the general calendar-date channel provision during the blackout.

citations.quote: the JFIU will cease accepting STR submissions via STREAMS at 12:00am on 28 January 2026, and will resume accepting STR submissions at 9:00am on 2 February 2026 via STREAMS 2
for any STRs requiring urgent submission during the blackout period of STREAMS, please contact the JFIU directly by email (jfiu@police.gov.hk), phone at 2866 3366 or fax at 2529 4013;

readings.distinction: Urgent blackout contact is a separate transitional instruction. Treating it as a post-launch alternative filing channel, or treating contact as completed filing, would add an outcome the text does not state.
questions: What establishes urgency, and what procedure follows direct contact?
Are reports contacted about during the blackout later subject to an express filing or resubmission instruction?
readings.statement: For STRs requiring urgent submission during the stated blackout, the text directs contact with the JFIU by the listed email, phone or fax. This includes the pre-launch hours of 2 February 2026. The packet does not establish whether contact itself completes submission; exact timestamp boundaries and that outcome are not formalized.
readings.subject: Blackout urgent-contact exception

assumptions: Following implementation is provisionally read against the expressly stated launch time.
The obligation is assessed separately from the initial channel control.

citations.quote: For STRs submitted to the JFIU via channels other than STREAMS 2 following its implementation, licensed firms are required to re-submit the STRs via STREAMS 2.
The JFIU will provide guidance to facilitate the re-submission.
All STRs previously submitted through STREAMS will be migrated to STREAMS 2.

readings.distinction: The text imposes a corrective duty after an off-channel submission; it does not say that later resubmission retroactively satisfies the initial channel requirement. Automatic migration of previous STREAMS records is a different arrangement.
questions: When must resubmission occur, and what evidence links it to the original STR?
Does the promised guidance address blackout contacts?
readings.statement: A licensed firm that submits an STR to the JFIU through another channel following implementation must separately re-submit that STR through STREAMS 2. No completion deadline or retrospective cure of the original channel failure is specified.
readings.subject: Separate off-channel resubmission obligation

assumptions: Intending to submit via XML is the stated trigger, which can arise before an actual filing.
Arranging a technical test is distinct from proving that a test has passed.

citations.quote: licensed firms that intend to submit STRs via the XML format are required to follow the XML schema provided separately by the JFIU and liaise with it as soon as possible to arrange a technical test to ensure a smooth transition.

readings.distinction: Choosing a permitted XML format under the selected filing control does not exhaust XML-specific duties. The text requires schema conformity and prompt liaison, but does not expressly make successful test completion a filing prerequisite.
questions: How is as soon as possible assessed, and does separate guidance impose a test-passing prerequisite?
readings.statement: Licensed firms intending to submit XML STRs must follow the separately provided JFIU schema and liaise with the JFIU as soon as possible to arrange a technical test. Missing schema contents and the contextual timing standard prevent a complete executable determination here.
readings.subject: XML schema and technical-test liaison dependencies
